title: fang's help path still queries the terminal: --help ~9s on a silent pty
description:
fang@v1.0.0's helpFunc (fang.go:132) calls mustColorscheme -> lipgloss.HasDarkBackground before rendering any help, so every `--help`/`help` invocation pays the OSC 11/DA1 query pair on a terminal (~2s of timeout each way on one that does not answer), stacked on finding 1's init cost: `script -q /dev/null ticfac --help` = 9.0s. Not a stall — no key reader holds stdin on the help path — but the same query machinery, out of tick jmf's named scope (the exit path), so it is reported rather than folded in.
evidence: fang@v1.0.0/fang.go:132 (helpFunc -> mustColorscheme, same call as fang.go:175); command: time script -q /dev/null ticfac --help = 9.0s, OSC 11 bytes visible on the wire
